description: The spec types the bulk_stream request body only as application/x-ndjson, which the OpenAPI converter does not read, so the operations had no body member and could not send one. Add a required string body sent verbatim as application/x-ndjson, the way cloudflare vectorize/insertIndex-ndjson-body does. Source: the requestBodies.bulk_stream entry of the official spec, and https://docs.opensearch.org/latest/api-reference/document-apis/bulk/ for the line format.

traits.smithy.api#documentation: Actions and documents as newline-delimited JSON (application/x-ndjson): an action line, then the document line for actions that take one. End the body with a newline.
